title: Fix admin panel access issue

requirements.text: Debug and fix the admin panel access issue by verifying the authentication flow in AdminGuard component and ensuring proper admin authorization checks in the backend actor's isAdmin method

quotes: Im Unable to access admin Panel

acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users with admin privileges can successfully access /admin route
AdminGuard component correctly validates both authentication state and admin status
Clear error messages displayed for unauthenticated users and non-admin users
Admin panel loads without errors and displays dashboard statistics and management tabs

requirements.text: Verify that the backend isAdmin method correctly identifies admin principals and returns proper authorization status
acceptanceCriteria: isAdmin method returns true for authorized admin principals
isAdmin method returns false for non-admin users
Admin authorization persists across browser sessions
No unauthorized users can access admin-only backend methods

requirements.text: Add error logging and user-friendly error messages to AdminGuard to help diagnose access issues when authentication or authorization fails
acceptanceCriteria: Console logs display detailed authentication state when admin access is denied
Users see clear instructions on how to gain admin access (e.g., 'Please contact the store owner')
Loading state is properly handled while checking admin status
Network errors are caught and displayed with retry options

constraints: Do not modify the Internet Identity authentication flow in useInternetIdentity hook
Maintain existing admin authorization logic structure in backend
Keep AdminGuard component's alert-based UI pattern for unauthorized access messages
nonGoals: Implementing new admin user management features
Adding role-based access control beyond basic admin/non-admin
Redesigning the admin panel UI layout
Implementing OTP sign-in or GPS location features
